editorial:
Imagine you are stressed out from work and your rich friend invites you to a fancy island for a murder-mystery game. That is exactly what happens to Dr. Emilia Priestly. She thinks she is just playing a game at a luxury resort, but things turn real very quickly when the owner of the island is actually killed. You get to follow Emilia as she uses her psychiatrist skills to read people and figure out who is lying. The vibe is like a modern version of those old whodunit stories where everyone is a suspect and nobody can leave until the killer is caught.

You will really enjoy how the movie keeps you guessing with a few clever twists. The acting is solid, and the pacing moves fast enough that you won't get bored. While some of the clues are a bit obvious, it is still a fun ride. If you love a good puzzle, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the murder was not a random act but a plan for revenge. After Emilia and Detective Trent dig into the past, they find out that one of the original investors killed the founder to cover up a old financial crime. Once the killer is caught and the police take them away, the survivors finally leave the island. Emilia finds a new sense of peace and a possible romance with the detective.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a classic whodunit mystery with a modern twist.
